ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a new species
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist with a passion for animals has spotted a wild Pokémon of a species the colony doesn't have, and wants to catch it.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony catches a Pokémon of a species it doesn't have yet. There's a wild {SUBJECT} out there, for a start.

plain.li: There's a wild {SUBJECT} out by the tree line, and nobody here has one yet. Let me take a belt and go after it.
I've been watching that {SUBJECT} for two days. I know where it goes to drink.
[winter] The {SUBJECT} comes down to the water on cold mornings. That's when I'd try for it.
[child] Can I catch the {SUBJECT}? I'll be careful with the ball.
[lowmood] I need something to work toward. That {SUBJECT} out there would do.

warm.li: That {SUBJECT} would do well here. I'd make sure it's looked after.

blunt.li: Give me a ball belt and an afternoon. The {SUBJECT} is coming home.

cheerful.li: A wild {SUBJECT}, right out past the fields! We don't have one of those yet.

gloomy.li: If we wait, that {SUBJECT} will wander off, and we won't see another for a long time.

cold.li: The colony has no {SUBJECT}. Catching one costs a ball and an afternoon.

plain.li: It's in the ball. I'll let it out once it's calmer.
That's one kind of creature the colony didn't have this morning.

warm.li: Thank you for letting me go after it. I'll look after it.

cheerful.li: Come and see what I caught!

gloomy.li: Caught it. Now I have to keep it alive.

cold.li: Done. One more species for the colony.

plain.li: It's gone over the hills. Maybe it'll come back this way.

blunt.li: It got away. Next time, let me go when I ask.

gloomy.li: Gone. I knew it would be.

plain.li: The {SUBJECT} is still out there. It won't be for long.

warm.li: Whenever someone can spare me for an afternoon. The {SUBJECT} hasn't left yet.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a Pokémon of my own
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist who has no Pokémon of their own wants one: one of the colony's that has no trainer yet, or a wild one caught for them.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {FOR_nameDef} is the trainer of a Pokémon: its master in the Animals tab. The {SUBJECT} would do.

plain.li: Everyone with a belt has a Pokémon at their heels. I'd like one too. The {SUBJECT} has nobody.
I've been watching how the trainers do it. I think I could. Let me start with the {SUBJECT}.
[child] Can the {SUBJECT} be mine? I'll train it every single day.
[lowmood] I need something that's on my side. A Pokémon of my own would be a start.

warm.li: That {SUBJECT} needs someone to look after it properly. I'd like to be the one.

blunt.li: Give me the {SUBJECT}. I'll make something of it.

cheerful.li: A Pokémon of my very own! The {SUBJECT}! We'll be the best team in the colony!

gloomy.li: Even the Pokémon have someone. I'd settle for the {SUBJECT}, if it would have me.

cold.li: A Pokémon without a trainer gains nothing in a fight. Assign the {SUBJECT} to me.

plain.li: It looks at me before it does anything now. I think that means something.

warm.li: We'll look after each other, the two of us.

cheerful.li: Watch this! Well, it'll do it next time.

plain.li: Never mind. Maybe a Pokémon has to pick its trainer, not the other way round.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: ball belts on the rack
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A trainer, or someone who loves animals, wants the colony to keep a few ball belts on hand while there are wild Pokémon about.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {TARGET} ball belts in the colony, worn or on the shelf. The colony can make {THING} now.

plain.li: There are wild Pokémon all over the land, and we have one belt between us. Let's make a few.
Every time something rare wanders past, someone has to run back for the belt. Keep a few on the rack.
[skill:Crafting] I'll make the belts myself if someone fetches the materials.

warm.li: A few spare belts, so whoever sees something first can go after it.

blunt.li: One belt isn't enough. Make more.

cheerful.li: Belts for everyone! Then we can all go catching!

gloomy.li: We'll miss the next rare one too, with one belt. We always do.

cold.li: Each missed catch is a species we may not see again. Belts are cheap by comparison.

plain.li: Belts on the rack. Next time something wanders past, we're ready.
One belt, then. We'll take turns.
